question: Chandragupta Maurya’s capital was:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pataliputra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Mauryan empire lasted from about 321 to 185 BCE.
 
 
• **Pataliputra** was the capital of the Mauryan empire.
 
• The area around Pataliputra was under the direct control of the emperor.
